title: Waiting Period Conditions Under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders
content:
The member's certificate for an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider carries the following conditions on the waiting period the rider is taken subject to.

## Condition 1 — the months the rider carries

The waiting period is the number of months from the rider effective date before benefits are payable. On the rider held, that number is:

| Rider | Waiting period (months) | Waived where the rider is taken as the medical plan first begins | Waived on proof of earlier comparable coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 3 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 6 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 6 | no | yes |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 6 | yes | yes |

## Condition 2 — the two waivers

2.1 The second column of the table above states whether the waiting period is waived for a member taking the rider when their medical plan first begins.

2.2 The third column states whether proof of earlier comparable coverage waives the waiting period.

## Condition 3 — reading the schedule

3.1 Two of the six riders carry no waiting period at all: the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider, each at 0 months.

3.2 The Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider carries the shortest waiting period of those that carry one, at 3 months; the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider, the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider each carry 6.

3.3 The Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider is the single rider in the schedule whose waiting period is not waived for a member taking it as their medical plan first begins; every rider in the schedule, that one included, waives it on proof of earlier comparable coverage.
